articleBodyHtml:
Introduction to the Ephemerals

The Ephemerals are a unique group of people who inhabit a world of sand. This world is distinct from other known environments, characterized by its vast deserts and shifting dunes. The term 'Ephemerals' suggests that these individuals may have a transient or temporary existence within this world.

The speaker confirms that the Ephemerals are indeed the people being referred to in the context of the world of sand. This confirmation is crucial for understanding the narrative and setting of the story.
